see_for_yourself.expected: Imported slots match your free time; the confirmed dates appear in your Google Calendar; the No and cancelled dates disappear from it.
steps: Sign in at rehearse.dalan.dev in a group you organize
My availability, Import from Google Calendar, grant access, untick one slot, save
On Schedule, propose and confirm a weekly rehearsal next week
Connect Google Calendar, then Add rehearsals to my Google Calendar
Answer No for one date and cancel another as organizer
